visual.general_description: Photograph of a neurophysiology monitor screen showing colored waveform traces in a right column and a left column, with labels L2, L3, L4 and S1.
visual.detailed_description: Photograph of a monitoring display with a dark background and a grid of thin vertical lines. The word "right" is printed at the top left and "left" at the top center, with a vertical divider between the two halves. Four horizontal bands of paired colored traces (pink and orange, light blue and orange, purple and orange, yellow and orange) are labelled at the right edge "L2", "L3", "L4" and "S1". Each trace band shows spike-like responses; the right-side half shows larger, denser overlapping responses in the lower three bands, while the left-side half shows smaller responses with a clearer baseline. Small text strings above each trace, some containing non-Latin characters, are too small to read. No amplitude values are legible.
